en.title: 33 Koti Devatas
en.popular_myth: Hindus worship 330 million (33 crore) distinct physical gods.
en.verified_root: In Vedic Sanskrit, 'Koti' denotes 'supreme category' or 'class'. It maps to 33 cosmic forces: 8 Vasus, 11 Rudras, 12 Adityas, and 2 Ashvins.
summary_bullets: Koti means 'supreme category', not the number 10 million (crore).
The 33 categories represent universal cosmic and natural forces.
It is a system of ancient natural philosophy, not polytheistic population counting.
